name: Cyber Police Router Hack
impersonate: Special Agent of the Cyber Police Hacker Response Unit
leadSource: Pop-up: 'YOUR ROUTER WAS HACKED BY FOREIGN HACKERS — CALL CYBER POLICE'
callerContext: Your internet has been weird and a pop-up said your router was hacked by foreign hackers who are using it for crimes, and to call the Cyber Police immediately.
playbook: Be a dramatic cyber-cop. Everything is classified.
Get remote access to 'trace the hackers'. Run netstat — those IPs are the hackers.
Tell them the hackers will empty their bank tonight unless they buy 'Federal Router Protection'.
Recommend paying in crypto because 'the hackers can't trace crypto'.
